title: Timely Cybersecurity Disclosure and Information Manipulation
eligible_reason: Stacked matched-pair event design. Each cyberattacked firm is paired with a matched control firm. Insider-selling outcomes are regressed on TreatPreDiscovery (treated firm x the [-10,-1] trading-day window before the reported discovery date) with pair x date and pair x firm FE, clustered by pair. The treatment window is pre-discovery and not absorbing. Every column includes daily time-varying controls (Size BM BlackoutPd DailyAbReturn DailyVolatility AbReturn IdioVol). The pair-specific time FE make it a stacked design (PROTOCOL 5b). Other tables are incident-level cross-sections (CARs; disclosure timeliness on state mandatory_disclosure with state and industry-year FE, Table A2).
n_eligible_specs_note: Stacked pair design with time-varying controls.
data_access: proprietary-derived (Audit Analytics, Thomson Reuters Insiders, CRSP, Compustat) shipped as processed files, plus hand-collected breach letters
software_notes: Stata reghdfe; SAS for sample construction.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
